widgets_values:
Create a highly coherent 2x2 cinematic storyboard grid, four equal rectangular panels arranged in a clean square grid, thin black gutters between panels, no visible panel numbers, no captions, no text, no logos, no watermark. The image must look like four still frames from the same film, with one continuous visual story across all panels. Keep the same main character consistent in every panel: same face, same hairstyle, same outfit, same body proportions, same color palette, same identity, same cinematic universe. Each panel should show a different moment of the same scene, with clear continuity of action, lighting, environment, and camera direction. Use strong composition, readable silhouettes, controlled detail, no messy layout, no extra panels, no duplicated random characters.

Global style: ultra cinematic, high-end film still, realistic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, clean image structure, consistent color grading, professional storyboard composition, detailed but not cluttered, natural depth of field, high visual coherence.

Panel 1, top-left: the main character stands at the edge of a vast ruined futuristic city at dusk, wind moving through the clothes, broken skyscrapers in the distance, wide establishing shot, cold blue-gray light, dramatic clouds.

Panel 2, top-right: the same character walks deeper into the ruined city street, looking alert and cautious, abandoned vehicles and glowing fragments around, medium shot, camera slightly low, stronger rim light, dust floating in the air.

Panel 3, bottom-left: the same character discovers a mysterious glowing device half-buried in the street, kneeling down and reaching toward it, close medium shot, warm orange light from the device illuminating the face and hands, tense cinematic mood.

Panel 4, bottom-right: the device activates and opens a vertical portal of light behind the same character, the character turns back in shock, particles and wind swirl around, heroic wide shot, powerful contrast between warm portal light and cold ruined city background.

Negative requirements: no text, no subtitles, no comic speech bubbles, no random extra panels, no fifth panel, no broken grid, no inconsistent face, no outfit changes, no multiple unrelated characters, no messy collage, no distorted hands, no duplicated bodies, no over-sharpened details, no noisy texture.

图像重绘细节强度设置 
degrade_sigma：0.2（默认值）

理解为重绘强度，数值越高重绘越强和原图越不相似

默认设置 0.20（中等强度）
放大重绘时，重新生成大量高清细节：皮肤毛孔、布料纹路、建筑纹理、景物层次明显变锐利；原图不会被大幅篡改

数值调高（0.3～0.6）
超高倍率下能填充巨量超细纹理，画面极致清晰；
风险：容易改动原图五官、物体造型，出现脸部崩坏、物体变形、色彩偏移，

数值过高（＞0.7）
原图 latent 几乎被噪声覆盖，相当于重绘一张全新图，原图构图、人物会完全走形，仅适合纯重绘不保留原图的场景。

5. 数值＜0.1（0.05~0.1，）
几乎不破坏原图，仅小幅补充边缘锐度，适合轻度放大、需要严格保留原图所有细节的场景。
